family.z_reference: Zg: the actual aligned controller/gland and sensor crimp axes.

derivation.profile: z(u) = -d * sin(pi*u/S)^2, d = 3 mm, S = 3 + pi*55/2 mm; zero slope at u=0 and u=S.
derivation.profile_placement: After the first 5 mm straight outside the gland, across the remaining 3 mm straight and the quarter arc; ends before the final 10 mm straight sensor jacket support land.
derivation.bound_reason: The horizontal path is parameterized by arclength and has curvature <=1/55. Vertical profile adds |z_second|<=2*d*pi^2/S^2; the full 3D curvature denominator can only reduce this conservative bound.

assumptions: Existing approximate wire-exit/wall coordinates; actual crimp offset <= 14 mm requires CAD confirmation.
Gland and sensor crimp axes equal height; glass plane offset and support height remain to determine.
Proposed sensor jacket support land 10 mm and breakout 20 mm; clamp/clip mechanism is not designed.
R50  is the minimum centreline design radius; the optional R55  route has a conservative 3D curvature bound above R50 .
Low point geometry does not establish splash or ingress acceptance.
status: Hypothetical laid harness centreline; end allocations and mated geometry are not physically verified.
height_relation: support_surface_height = rim_height + sensor_crimp_height_above_rim - installed_gland_axis_height_above_support; includes base/feet offset.
